<documents>
<document id="cash-deposit-retail">
DepositingˆcashˆatˆaˆstoreˆYouˆcanˆaddˆcashˆtoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆatˆparticipatingˆretailˆstores.ˆOpenˆtheˆapp,ˆtapˆCash,ˆthenˆDepositˆcash,ˆandˆshowˆtheˆbarcodeˆtoˆtheˆcashierˆwithˆyourˆcash.ˆ##ˆFeesˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆFeeˆperˆdepositˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆcashˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$2,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆFundsˆusuallyˆappearˆwithinˆminutes.ˆKeepˆtheˆstoreˆreceiptˆuntilˆyouˆseeˆtheˆdepositˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆThingsˆtoˆknowˆ-ˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆdon'tˆacceptˆcashˆdeposits.ˆ-ˆTheˆbarcodeˆisˆvalidˆforˆoneˆdepositˆonly.ˆ-ˆStoresˆsetˆtheirˆownˆmaximumˆperˆvisit,ˆwhichˆcanˆbeˆlowerˆthanˆyourˆdailyˆlimit.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="cushion-repayment">
RepayingˆCushionˆWhenˆCushionˆcoversˆaˆpurchase,ˆyourˆbalanceˆgoesˆbelowˆzero.ˆHere'sˆhowˆitˆgetsˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆAutomaticˆrepaymentˆAnyˆmoneyˆthatˆcomesˆin,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆrefund,ˆgoesˆtowardˆtheˆnegativeˆbalanceˆfirst.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆyourselfˆYouˆcanˆaddˆmoneyˆatˆanyˆtimeˆbyˆtransfer,ˆBrookPayˆfromˆanotherˆmember,ˆorˆaˆcashˆdepositˆatˆaˆstore.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆstaysˆnegativeˆ-ˆAfterˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆuntilˆyou'reˆbackˆatˆzeroˆandˆmeetˆtheˆdirectˆdepositˆrequirementˆagain.ˆ-ˆAfterˆ60ˆdays,ˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestricted.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆaddˆmoney,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆspendˆorˆsendˆitˆuntilˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterestˆforˆusingˆCushion,ˆandˆnoneˆforˆrepayingˆlate.ˆTheˆonlyˆconsequencesˆareˆsuspensionˆandˆrestriction.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccountˆwhileˆit'sˆnegative?ˆNo.ˆBringˆtheˆbalanceˆtoˆzeroˆfirst.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
